description: One found item that may be the owner's lost item. Returned only inside getReport (GET /reports/{reportId}), and only to the report's owner. Explicit allowlist: no scoreParts, notifiedAt or reportId (internal Matches attributes), no finderId, no email. The item is an ItemSummary: its photo is always present here, even for a wallet-id item, and it has no description, clipTags or returnedAt.

score.description: Whole percent. A pair is a match at the matching Lambda's threshold (default 60) or more.

why.description: Short plain sentences that explain the score.
